resource.title: VLSI Design Automation（上海科技大学 SIST，Pingqiang Zhou，Spring 2016 课程站与讲义）
resource.access: 免费公开访问课程站与讲义 PDF（课程为 2016 春季学期存档，站点在上海科技大学教师主页下）
resource.covers: 原文课程描述覆盖：计算布尔代数（BDD、SAT）、二级与多级逻辑综合、技术映射、物理设计（划分、布图规划、布局、布线）、时序分析、模拟退火等大规模优化启发式；简介里的逻辑综合与布尔优化、技术映射、划分、布局、布线、静态时序分析均有对应。未覆盖电路仿真算法（SPICE/数值积分）与物理验证（DRC/LVS）。讲义正文为英文（课程在中国开设不等于中文授课）。

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: ELENG 66 and CS 70. ELENG 64 and CS 61C strongly recommended.
courses.scope_text: This course is an introduction to design automation, concerned with rigorous methods and tools for the modeling, design, and analysis of complex engineered systems. Topics include design flows, discrete and continuous modeling techniques, and fundamental synthesis, verification, and simulation algorithms. Integrated circuit design will be used as a central example, augmented by examples from cyber-physical systems and software design.
CATALOG DESCRIPTION : Basic concepts in VLSI CAD with emphasis on physical design, fundamental algorithms for CAD problems, development of CAD tools.

courses.school: The University of Texas at Dallas
courses.course: EEDG 6375 (CE 6375) Design Automation of VLSI Systems
courses.scope_text: This course deals with various topics related to the development of CAD tools for VLSI systems design. Algorithms, data structures, heuristics and design methodologies behind CAD tools. Design and analysis of algorithms for layout, circuit partitioning, placement, routing, chip floor planning, and design rule checking

notes: Northwestern COMP_SCI 208 的课程页标题为“COMP_SCI 208: (214) Data Structures and Algorithms”（主代理 2026-11-22 打开核对 https://www.mccormick.northwestern.edu/computer-science/academics/courses/descriptions/208.html）。Berkeley EECS 144 的 CS 70 为离散数学与概率，EE 66 为信号与系统入门；EE 64、CS 61C 只是强烈建议。中文没有找到系统讲 EDA 算法的公开课程。
